record.what_it_does: SEO platform with APIs for keyword, backlink, SERP, audit and rank-tracking data.
record.auth_notes: REST APIs (Data, Project, Local Marketing and SE Visible) use an account API key in the header 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY' against https://api.seranking.com. Some guides also accept an 'apikey' query parameter. One key works for both the Data and Project APIs. OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration exists only on the hosted MCP server, which also accepts the X-Api-Key header. Sub-accounts can't use MCP OAuth. No OAuth app flow for the REST API and no scoped keys were found.
record.access_notes: The API comes with a subscription (Core $129/mo, which includes 25K API credits and MCP access; Growth $279/mo with 100K credits; Enterprise custom). A 14-day free trial needs no credit card, and the API page says the API can be tested in the trial account. Extra credits are sold as an annual API Add-On from $540/yr (about $45/mo) for 3M credits, or as pay-as-you-go packs from $50 for 250K credits that never expire. Data API calls consume credits. Each end user needs their own SE Ranking account and key.
record.api_breadth_notes: The Data API covers Backlinks, Domain Analysis, Keyword Research, AI Search, Website Audit and Account System. There are also separate Project API (rank tracking, sites, keywords, competitors), Local Marketing API and SE Visible API sections. Combined endpoints very likely exceed 50, but I did not count them exactly.
record.mcp_notes: Hosted at https://api.seranking.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, or the X-Api-Key header). Docs are at seranking.com/api/integrations/mcp/. The vendor's GitHub org also publishes a self-hostable server, github.com/seranking/seo-data-api-mcp-server, which uses the SERANKING_API_TOKEN env var.
record.blocker_notes: A developer can test on the 14-day free trial (no card needed). Lasting use needs a paid subscription, and Data API calls consume credits. The REST API offers only full-access API keys, with no third-party OAuth app flow, so users must paste their own keys.
